# Iris Holidays

> > Award-winning Kerala tour operator specializing in customized packages covering backwaters, houseboats, hill stations, Ayurveda retreats, and international destinations from Kochi, India.

Iris Holidays offers 80+ curated tour packages with expertise in Kerala destinations including Munnar, Thekkady, Kumarakom, Alleppey, and Fort Kochi. The operator also provides international packages to Thailand, Dubai, Bali, Turkey, and Lakshadweep, catering to honeymooners, solo travelers, and cultural enthusiasts.

## Key Topics

- Kerala backwater tours
- Houseboat cruises
- Munnar hill station
- Thekkady wildlife

- Fort Kochi heritage
- Ayurveda retreats
- Honeymoon packages
- Alleppey houseboats
- Kovalam beach holidays
- Cultural tours

- International tours from Kochi
- Temple tours
- Eravikulam National Park
